title: The First Game of the Eternal Ages
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Ji stepped onto the Void Chessboard, the Tianji Record Fragment shuddered violently—and the next page that had never appeared before slowly revealed a name that caught his attention.

text.content:
The Void is boundless, Hongmeng unopened.

Chen Ji floated in a darkness that even spiritual sense could not penetrate, with no reference coordinates around him. He couldn't remember how he had arrived here—as if in a single thought, the chess game beneath his feet had transformed into a gaping maw devouring all things.

He tried to circulate spiritual energy, only to find the Tianji Record Fragment within his body vibrating at an unprecedented frequency.

dialogue.content: (Thought) The intensity of this vibration... is a hundred times more violent than when I touched the forbidden object in the Falling God Abyss all those years ago.

text.content:
Just then, a faint light gleamed in the darkness.

The glow did not originate from any specific direction but seemed to seep from the very source of time itself. It was not dazzling, yet impossible to look at directly; it was not scorching hot, yet appeared capable of incinerating all existence into nothingness.

The light slowly unfurled, sketching out the outline of a chessboard—nineteen lines each for length and breadth, symbolizing the方圆 of heaven and earth and the运转 of all things. Upon the board were scattered black and white pieces, each emitting an aura that made his heart tremble.

Those were... the remnant souls of Heavenly Fate bearers throughout the ages.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply.

He recognized several of the black pieces—were these not the prognosticators recorded in classical texts, those erased by the Celestial Eye? So their remnant souls had not dissipated after all, but were instead refined into this chess game.

text.content:
"You have come."

A voice rang out from all directions simultaneously, sounding both like the whispered murmurs of an ancient deity and like the rumbling of heaven's workings. The voice carried no emotional fluctuations, yet it caused every single hair on Chen Ji's body to stand on end.

He instinctively retreated half a step, only to discover his feet had sunk into the chessboard, rendering him immobile.

dialogue.content:
"Since ancient times, countless fools who claimed to be heaven's chosen have attempted to peer into this chessboard—"

The voice paused, as if something in the darkness was gazing at him.

"All were reduced to powder."

text.content:
The moment the words fell, the turtle shell artifact in Chen Ji's embrace shuddered violently, emitting a mournful keening. He looked down to find golden cracks spreading across the ancient shell that had accompanied him through life and death.

The trajectory of those cracks... bore a striking resemblance to the patterns on a chessboard.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji forcibly suppressed his surging qi, his expression remaining unmoved.

"(Thought) The turtle shell has never reacted this way before... Could it be that this moment is precisely what it has been waiting for?"

text.content:
In the darkness, that gazing attention seemed to become filled with leisurely interest.

"Interesting."

The Celestial Eye's voice actually carried a hint of... appreciation?

"You are different from the other pieces. Before me, you have neither knelt in submission nor succumbed to madness."

Chen Ji felt the pressure intensify by several degrees, his chest constricting as he barely managed to hold back a mouthful of blood. Yet his spine straightened even more, and the corner of his lips even curved into a faint smile.

On the chessboard, the remnant soul pieces of past Heavenly Fate bearers trembled slightly, as if sensing something.

dialogue.content:
"This seat asks you—"

The voice suddenly pressed closer, the oppression nearly suffocating Chen Ji.

"Do you consider yourself a piece, or a player?"

text.content:
This was a question that left no retreat.

Saying piece would mean acknowledging oneself as a puppet to be manipulated; saying player would mean the height of arrogance—daring to play against heaven. And whichever answer he gave would determine the Celestial Eye's subsequent attitude toward him.

The turtle shell in Chen Ji's embrace vibrated increasingly violently, those golden cracks having spread across the entire shell surface.

choice.prompt: The Celestial Eye's questioning hung like a sword overhead, and Chen Ji had to respond. His choice at this moment would determine the opening posture of this eternal chess game.

choices.description: To engage the Celestial Eye as an equal, acknowledging oneself as a participant in the chess game rather than a passive piece
choices.visible_reward: Gain qualification to dialogue with heaven as an equal
choices.risk_hint: The Celestial Eye may view this as provocation

text.content:
Chen Ji slowly raised his head, gazing directly into that nonexistent gaze within the void.

"The junior is neither a piece nor a player."

His voice echoed through the void, calm to the point of coldness.

"The junior is merely... that piece in the hand of the chess player. However—"

He pivoted, his eyes flashing with brilliant light.

"—the chess player is but a piece in another game."

At this moment, the cracks on the turtle shell artifact suddenly ceased their spread, as if waiting for something.

choices.description: Use a humble posture as a retreat to probe the Celestial Eye's bottom line and intentions
choices.visible_reward: Gather more information about the Eye of Heavenly Way
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Way may see through thoughts

text.content:
Chen Ji slightly bowed, adopting a deferential posture.

"I am merely a mortal, blessed by the heavens to reach where I am today. Before you, Senior, I am naturally just a chess piece."

He paused, his sidelong glance sweeping across the chessboard at those soul fragments.

"However... I venture to ask, Senior, what is the purpose of this ancient chess game spanning countless ages?"

choices.description: Maintain a mysterious demeanor, not readily revealing trump cards or thoughts
choices.visible_reward: Expose no thoughts, maintain maximum initiative
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Way may lose patience

text.content:
Chen Ji did not answer.

He simply stood there quietly, allowing the overwhelming pressure to surge over his soul like tides. His gaze remained calm as still water, as if this presence that had terrified countless Heavenly Fate bearers throughout history was merely an ordinary chess piece on the board.
The turtle shell's tremors grew increasingly intense, and within those golden cracks, a faint light began to emerge.

In the Void, the passage of time became indistinguishable. Chen Ji did not know how long he endured under that pressure—perhaps a moment, perhaps a hundred years.

Just as he felt he was about to collapse, the pressure suddenly receded like a tide pulling back.

dialogue.content:
"Ha..."

A low chuckle rang out from all directions.

"Throughout the ages, you are the first to dare remain silent before me."

text.content:
Chen Ji's heart tightened. He sensed a subtle shift in the Eye of Heavenly Way's attitude—it was no longer the condescending scrutiny from before, but carried a hint of... the interest a hunter regards prey with.

This was even more dangerous.

dialogue.content:
"Do you think silence can protect what's in your heart?"

The Eye of Heavenly Way's voice carried a trace of mockery.

"Everything recorded in that fragment within you is, to my eyes, merely an open book."

text.content:
Chen Ji's expression slightly changed, but he quickly regained his composure.

He knew his Tianji Record had been completely seen through by his opponent, but he also understood—if the Eye of Heavenly Way truly had absolute control, why bother talking to him?

This itself proved that beyond the Tianji Record, there were things it could not glimpse.

dialogue.content:
"Since Senior has already seen through me, I shall no longer hide."

Chen Ji smiled faintly, his eyes gleaming.

"Indeed, I am merely a chess piece. But has Senior ever considered—"

text.content:
He paused, his gaze sweeping across the chessboard at those pieces radiating soul fragment aura.

"—whether the chess player wishes to be manipulated?"

At this moment, the Turtle Shell Artifact erupted with a blinding radiance, and those golden cracks transformed into intricate mystical patterns, seared into the Void!

choice.prompt: The Turtle Shell Artifact's sudden transformation broke the stalemate, granting Chen Ji a brief moment of respite. Should he press the advantage or settle for what he has gained?

choices.description: Leverage the shock from the Turtle Shell's transformation to continue pressuring the Eye of Heavenly Way
choices.visible_cost: Consumes a large amount of Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: May force the Eye of Heavenly Way to reveal more trump cards

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze sharpened, his hands forming seals as the Tianji Record Fragment and Turtle Shell both erupted with dazzling radiance. "Though merely a piece upon the board, this junior still possesses the heart of a chess player!"

He took a step forward, the first time actively advancing toward where Heaven's Eye resided. "The ancient game spanning eons, elder has plotted for countless ages. Has it ever crossed your mind—that a piece upon this board might awaken?"

choices.description: Quitting while ahead, forming a stalemate against Heaven's Eye in momentum
choices.visible_cost: Abandoning the opportunity to expand the advantage
choices.visible_reward: Preserving strength, leaving room for negotiation
choices.risk_hint: Heaven's Eye may seize back the initiative

text.content: Chen Ji did not advance further. Instead, he tucked the Turtle Shell into his chest, its radiance dimming. "Please forgive this junior, elder. That was merely desperate self-preservation."
He slightly clasped his hands in greeting, posture lowered, yet the gleam in his eyes remained undiminished. "I wonder what business brings this junior here, summoned by the elder?"

In the Void, that suffocating pressure unexpectedly slowly receded. Upon the chessboard, a piece never before seen descended from the heavens, landing steadily three chi before Chen Ji. It was an ink-black chess piece, its surface flowing with starry patterns, as if containing the operational laws of the entire cosmos.

dialogue.content: "Interesting." Heaven's Eye's voice rang out once more. This time, a thread of genuine interest had entered that playful tone. "Throughout the ages, countless Heavenly Fate bearers have before me either groveled or met heroic deaths. Yet you—"

text.content: That ink-black chess piece suddenly emitted a heart-piercing attraction. Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record Fragment within him shaking violently, as if wanting to tear free from his body. The cracks in the Turtle Shell also violently expanded at this moment, golden light facing the starry patterns of the black chess piece across the distance.

dialogue.content: "Yet you wish to play against me." That voice suddenly turned low and dangerous. "Since it is so, I shall grant you this opportunity."

text.content: Before the words finished, that ink-black chess piece abruptly flew up, smashing directly into the Turtle Shell in Chen Ji's chest. Boom—! A deafening roar exploded in Chen Ji's mind. His divine soul was forcibly pulled into chaos. Countless scenes flashed like a carousel—the memories of successive Heavenly Fate bearers, the truth of the eons-long chess game, and...

dialogue.content: Chen Ji violently opened his eyes, discovering he was no longer within the Void chessboard. He stood upon a vast snowy plain. Amid the swirling snow, a white-robed figure stood with hands clasped behind his back, back turned to him. That figure... why did it seem so familiar?

choice.prompt: The scene shifted abruptly. Chen Ji found himself upon an unfamiliar snowy plain. That white-robed figure exuded an aura that even the Tianji Record would tremble before. At this moment, he had to make a choice.

choices.description: Breaking the silence, probing the other's identity with a proactive stance
choices.risk_hint: The other party may be an incarnation of Heaven's Eye

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, straightened his robes, then calmly spoke. "Junior Chen Ji, greeting the elder."
His voice was steady and clear, carrying far through the howling wind and snow. "May I inquire the elder's honored name, and in what capacity this junior is being received?"

choices.description: Waiting for the other party to speak first, responding to change with constancy
choices.risk_hint: The opponent may take the initiative

text.content:
Chen Ji did not speak, merely standing quietly in place, his gaze fixed upon that white-robed figure in the distance.

The wind and snow howled, yet they could not move the person's robes by even a fraction.

Chen Ji noticed that the white-robed figure's right hand was always hidden behind his back, as if deliberately concealing something. And where he stood, the snow for several zhang in all directions had transformed into a crystal-clear ice surface, reflecting the swirling snow and the dim sky.

This is... What level of Ice Laws is this?

The white-robed figure slowly turned around.

It was a face so perfectly sculpted as to seem unreal, with brows like distant mountains and eyes like deep pools, surrounded by a faint mist of immortality. A subtle, enigmatic smile played at the corner of his lips, a smile that in Chen Ji's eyes felt colder than any blade.

dialogue.content:
"My name is—Cang Jie."

The white-robed figure's voice was like ten-thousand-year-old frozen ice, each word carrying the power to freeze souls.

"Or, you may call this one... the本体 of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets."

text.content:
Chen Ji's pupils constricted.

Cang Jie—that was the supreme deity who created writing in legend, the supreme existence who communicated with heaven and earth and commanded creation. But in all legends about Cang Jie, no one had ever mentioned his connection to the Eye of Heavenly Secrets.

And now, this existence that should belong only to myth was examining him with a condescending attitude.

dialogue.content:
"No need for astonishment."

Cang Jie raised his hand, and at his fingertip condensed a black-and-white chess piece, slowly rotating in the wind and snow.

"This one is merely a wisp of thought projection. The true body has long merged with the Heavenly Dao."

text.content:
Chen Ji forcibly suppressed the turbulent waves in his heart, yet his expression remained composed.

"I see. Then may I ask why the senior reveals himself in his true form—is it to seriously play a game of chess with this junior?"

dialogue.content:
Cang Jie smiled lightly, that smile carrying a hint of amusement.

"A game of chess? You overestimate yourself."

He flipped his wrist, and that black-and-white chess piece transformed into flowing light, shooting directly into Chen Ji's brow center.

"This one merely wishes to see how far this variable of yours can go in this chess game."

text.content:
Chen Ji felt a cool sensation in his brow center, that chess piece had merged into his Mental Sea, standing alongside the Tianji Record Fragment. He attempted to use the Tianji Record to deduce the origin of this chess piece, yet all deductions sank like stones to the bottom of the sea, not stirring even the slightest ripple.

This was not an ordinary forbidden restriction, but—

"The Seed of Causality." Cang Jie seemed to read his thoughts, "By planting this, there will be a karmic connection between you and this one. No matter where you go, this one can sense your existence."

The wind and snow suddenly ceased.

Cang Jie's figure began to fade, as if ready to dissipate into heaven and earth at any moment. Before taking his leave, he left one final words.

"Live well, Chen Ji. This one looks forward to—seeing what kind of chess game you can walk in this lifetime."

As the words fell, the white-robed figure vanished completely, leaving only an endless snow plain, and the turtle shell artifact in Chen Ji's arms that was violently trembling.

Chen Ji stood alone on the snow plain.

Everything that had just occurred felt like an absurd dream, yet the cool sensation of that Seed of Causality at his brow center served as a constant reminder—this was no dream.

The Eye of Heavenly Secrets'本体 was actually the supreme deity Cang Jie who created writing in legend. The truth of the Eternal Chess Game was far more terrifying than he had imagined.

And he had been officially drawn into this game of chess.

The cracks on the turtle shell artifact slowly healed, but in its depths, a line of golden text that had never appeared before slowly emerged—

That was the next page of the Tianji Record.
